login.title: Gym Fee Reminder
login.tagline: Fees track karo, reminder ek tap me bhejo.
login.cardDescription: Apne Google account se sign in karo. Koi password yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.
login.footnote: Gym owners ke liye. Members ko koi app install nahi karni.

onboarding.title: Apna gym add karo
onboarding.description: Ek baar ka setup. Iske baad members add karna shuru kar sakte ho.

memberForm.title: Naya member
memberForm.name: Naam
memberForm.feeHint: Abhi tay nahi hua? Khaali chhod do — pehli payment ke waqt bhar sakte ho.
memberForm.periodHint: End date hi agli due date banegi.

memberDetail.noFeeNote: Monthly fees set nahi hai, isliye total nahi nikal sakta.
memberDetail.noPayments: Abhi tak koi payment record nahi hui.
memberDetail.removeDescription: Member list se hat jayega, par uski payment history safe rahegi. Dobara join kare to wapas la sakte ho.

reminders.subtitle: Tap karo, WhatsApp khulega, message pehle se likha hoga.
reminders.emptyDetail: Sab members ki fees time pe hai.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reminderDaysHint: Due date se itne din pehle member "due soon" dikhega.
settings.appLanguageHint: Sirf tumhe jo dikhta hai wo badlega. Members pe koi asar nahi.
settings.messageLanguageHint: Tumhare members ko WhatsApp pe jo message jata hai, uski language.

feePlans.title: Fee plans
feePlans.description: Ek baar daal do, phir member add karte waqt aur payment lete waqt bas tap karna hoga. Bundle sasta ho sakta hai — jaise 1 month ₹400, 2 months ₹700.
feePlans.empty: Abhi koi plan nahi. Neeche add karo.
